newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy issues 2.1 million new shares.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy issues 2.1 million new shares.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said it sold 2.1 million new shares of common stock in block trades for net proceeds of $64.1 million.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes and to retire debt used to fund investments in the utility holding company's international energy businesses.
The sale of shares represents the completion of the shelf registration the company filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission in June 1995.
With the new issue, CMS Energy said it now has 94.6 million common shares outstanding.
